note: Source data for inventory.md, the canvas and inventory-3x.png. Every image in inventory-png/ is rendered from index.html itself (its own functions, sprite and CSS) in headless Chromium at deviceScaleFactor 12, so 1 css px = 12 image px; context shots are DSF 3. Fields: name, where used, drawing style, sizes it renders at, png, index.html line(s).

groups.title: Category glyphs
groups.sub: 11 sprite symbols (<symbol id="g-*">, viewBox 0 0 24 24). Filled silhouettes in currentColor, square corners; only district and street are stroked. Colour = the category ink (CATEGORY_COLORS). Shown alone in the ink, then at the three sizes they render at: 12 (filter chip), 18 (inside the 24px row badge and the 24px near map pin), 23 (inside the 32px selected pin). Far pins (16px) drop the glyph.
